title: Aisle 9 wrapper infeed — loaded truck, westbound
description: Synthetic reference scenario. A loaded counterbalance forklift travels west along Aisle 9. A pedestrian walks south from the break room to the returns cage, crossing the aisle beside the stretch-wrapper infeed, where pallets queue for wrapping. The queue and the wrapper hide the pedestrian from the driver.

incident.summary: Loaded forklift FL-12 braked for a clerk who stepped out from beside the wrapper infeed queue.
incident.narrative: Around 09:40 forklift FL-12, carrying a full pallet, was travelling west along Aisle 9. A returns clerk walked south from the break room to the returns cage using crossing X-15. Four pallets were queued at the wrapper infeed east of the crossing. The driver braked when the clerk appeared from behind the queue; the truck stopped with the forks close to the clerk, estimated at a little under half a metre. No contact.
